items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: So anyway, I made my first session when I got to New York with Harry James.

ctx.x: Well listen Helen, you know what I think is absolutely remarkable, and that is, all the records they put out are good, all their records are good. And they put out people, you know, that everybody here says, there's no money in them. Well, you know, like Jay or different people like that. They put all these different people together and they put their tours together and then they record their tours. And those records are always good. All of them are good. And yet

they are records you can't persuade people here to make. Let's say Harry Lim, and you say Harry, they may sound wonderful together. No, nothing happens. You can't sell them and yet they can sell them and they make wonderful records.
Yeah. But they don't send you No royalties.
